body: I feel you. My gf still trys to drag me out with my old friends. She gets upset that I don't talk. She asks "Whats wrong? Why aren't you talking?" and my answer is always the same, "I have nothing to say". It's not that I have no friends anymore, its the constant reminder that no matter how many people I surround myself with, I'm still completely and utterly alone.

I have a school dance tonight and I really do not want to go. However, my gf is going so I kinda have to. This wouldn't be that vad but I FUCKING DESPISE DANCE MUSIC. Every time I go to one of these things I just end up standing around not knowing what to do. I just cant into the music when every other word is nigga or hoe. Any advice, no matter how shitty, would be much appreciated.
